items.text: A new species of tiger cat is formally identified, the first newly recognized felid in over a century.
Former leader of Kosovo Hashim Thaçi is sentenced to twenty-five years in prison for war crimes during his leadership of the Kosovo Liberation Army.
In Turkey, hundreds of people are arrested in a crackdown on LGBTQ expression and subsequent protests.
A ferry sinks in the Java Sea, resulting in at least nine deaths and more than a hundred others missing.
